title: Progress Toward 4,000-flat Target for Parenthood Provisional Housing Scheme
what_it_is: Progress Toward 4,000-flat Target for Parenthood Provisional Housing Scheme

sections.label: PPHS supply and allocation priority
sections.summary: HDB met its 4,000-unit PPHS target by end-2025, with priority tiers and recent selection rates for households.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: HDB has met its target of ramping up the PPHS supply to 4,000 units at the end of 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: In terms of allocation, households with at least one child aged 18 and below, as well as married couples expecting a child are given highest priority.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Married couples without children and households with older children are next in priority, followed by fiancé-fiancée couples.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: In recent exercises, all households in the highest priority tier and about 30% of households in the next priority tier were invited to select PPHS flats.

sections.label: Steady state and SERS flats
sections.summary: About 4,000 flats is assessed as the right steady state, alongside Shorter Waiting Time flats and limited SERS vacant flats.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Our assessment is that about 4,000 flats, and maybe just a little bit more, would be the right steady state.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Because in tandem with this, we are also ramping up the Shorter Waiting Time flats.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: In terms of whether that we are looking at additional flats, we are looking to see as many of the SERS vacant flats as we can.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: But there is a limited supply of vacant flats.

sections.label: PPHS ramp-up due to COVID
sections.summary: The PPHS ramp-up came about because of the housing crunch during COVID and difficulties meeting the building programme.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The PPHS ramp-up came about really because of the housing crunch due to the COVID period and the difficulties in meeting our building programme.
